_about: Stage E.28 Part A lead rulings v2, 2026-10-21 16:47 PDT, after RankingReviewer-FableXHigh (R_rank.md). v1 (A3_lead_rulings.json, sha256 82581c92...) stays on disk and every v1 ruling stands; v2 adds four rulings, each applying the frozen spec or the lead's own v1 clauses literally. The lead had seen the v1 ranking (top pair Topstep QG) when writing v2; each ruling below is the literal reading the reviewer identified, applied to every candidate it touches, not a choice among readings.

RR-01_C1b_all_unknown.ruling: Spec section 2, C1 (b): 'Unknown counts as high.' Where EVERY C1(b) evidence field a reader supplied for a candidate is UNKNOWN, (b) = high. Partial evidence stays as the blind scorer rated it (v1 ruling). Checked on the masked sheets: only C40 has all C1(b) fields UNKNOWN.

RR-03_C6_cap_unverified.ruling: OC-6's symmetric clause: a C6 >= 3 resting only on evidence known from an abstract or snippet is capped at 2. RankingReviewer found 13 such ratings (all grain labels, resting only on an OpenAlex abstract); they are capped at 2. The 5 equity C6 = 3 ratings rest on full text and stand.
RR-03_C6_cap_unverified.cap_labels: the 13 grain labels listed in R_rank.md RR-03

RR-04_topstep_R_micro.ruling: The blind scorer's stated primary reading for F03 (Topstep) is R_by_size: micro 4, non-micro 3 (its reasons: a cap a 1-contract strategy never reaches). score.py read the class dict instead; use R_by_size.

RR-05_lucid_fee.ruling: Lucid's table gives commission per side and never states whether exchange and NFA fees are included, so the all-in fee is unknown; the spec's rule applies: 'If a fee is unknown, the highest fee found for that product class at the other four firms is used and marked u.' Use the reviewer's recomputed Lucid economics (work/REV_rank/rr_econ_lucidalt.json) or recompute identically.
